description: This file provides high-level API functions for PHY (physical layer) configuration and access for RTL8367C switch chips. It includes functions for setting and getting PHY registers via MDIO/OCP interface, as well as auxiliary functions for Serdes register access.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 ocpData)
methods.description: Sets a PHY OCP register via the MDIO/OCP interface using the provided port number, address, and data.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYOCPReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 ocpAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Reads a PHY OCP register via the MDIO/OCP interface given port number and address.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 phyData)
methods.description: Sets a PHY register by address and port number.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicPHYReg(rtk_uint32 phyNo,rtk_uint32 phyAddr,rtk_uint32 * pRegData)
methods.description: Gets a PHY register by address and port number.

methods.name: ret_t rtl8367c_setAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 value)
ret_t rtl8367c_getAsicSdsReg(rtk_uint32 sdsId,rtk_uint32 sdsReg,rtk_uint32 sdsPage,rtk_uint32 * value)
